items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: Rico was playing bass... we worked there pretty, pretty good while. Oh, about six, eight, no, eleven months I think we worked there.

ctx.x: You remember him? Uptown. And Rico was playing bass. Rico, Alexis? Yeah. Yeah, we called him Rico, you know? Well, we worked there pretty, pretty good while. Oh, about six, eight, no, eleven months I think we worked there. When they sold a place to a guy that called Johnny something, and then, well, he decided to get rid of the band. He didn't want no music there, you know? And then when I left there, then I went to the ballet club. That's on Boynel Street. The ballet club is where the dream room is right now.…
He told us about Sidney Desveen's band, or just what it was like when you played with him?
